item.title: 6 Deeper sonar top tips
item.description: A quick but ‘in depth’ look at how to get the best results when using a Deeper sonar. 1. Aligning Waterproof Marks On Your Deeper Sonar: Why It Matters These marks indicate the correct seal position, ensuring the unit remains watertight for optimal performance and device longevity. Misalignment can lead to water ingress, risking internal damage, inaccurate readings, or complete device failure.
